# Thanh Nguyen

> Personal site of Thanh (Albert) Nguyen, software engineer. Distributed systems by day; browser tools, math write-ups and learning aids the rest of the time. Everything here is static HTML with no build step.

The home page is an interactive portrait with a single chat line and no visible text. Everything it can say is in the question bank: qa.json
The same content as prose: about.md

## Writing
- [Cube Algebra](cube_algebra_theory.md): a textbook-style development of the t-product algebra of 3-tensors, with a hardware thesis. Markdown with LaTeX math.

## Tools
- [Sophia & Ethan's Math Quest](https://sophiaethan.fun): free math game for kids aged 10 to 15+, in Vietnamese and English. 1,677 problems, including 600 original contest-style puzzles (Kangaroo, MATHCOUNTS, AMC 8/10/12, AIME and olympiad style).
- [Piano Practice Tools](piano/): ear trainer, note reader, fingering coach, play-by-ear with 290 public-domain tunes. Adaptive drills, offline capable.
- [JPython](jpython): Python interpreter in JavaScript, runs in the browser.
- [LaTeX Visualizer](latex): render LaTeX live, export PDF.
- [SRS](srs): small spaced-repetition system.

## Visualizations and simulations
- [Knowledge Map](knowledge/): force-directed graph of ~2,000 topics from books and courses. Data at knowledge/data.json
- [3D Solar System and Constellations](constellations) with facts in [JSON](constellations-data.json), [Game of Life](gameoflife)

## Elsewhere
- GitHub: https://github.com/traceformula
